name: record_customer_language_preference_hindi

branch: George Lin requests that Hindi be recorded as his preferred language for staff on his profile; the agent verifies him and records the language preference
tests: the agent verifies the customer and records their preferred language in preferences
instruction:
You are an existing customer. You want to update your customer profile preferences so that Hindi (language: hi) is your preferred language for staff.
